g.text: Restaurant Rush - sequence diagram (3/4): turns 8 and 9 - Happy Hour, READY, then SERVED
t = 8: Manager choice 1 - Happy Hour; the Pasta becomes READY
false: the Waiter acts before the Chef,
so the Pasta is not READY yet
t = 9: Manager choice 2 - serve the Critic now; the Critic reacts
polymorphic hook: Restaurant only knows Customer.
Regular and VIP inherit the empty default.
[turn - o3.readyTurn() > 1: the food waited, it is cold]
